mapper.sql: run_record_id AS runRecordId, runner_id AS runnerId, shoe_id AS shoeId, run_datetime AS runDatetime, run_date AS runDate, duration_sec AS durationSec, distance_km AS distanceKm, avg_pace_sec AS avgPaceSec, avg_hr AS avgHr, max_hr AS maxHr, condition_score AS conditionScore, pain_area_code AS painAreaCode, pain_level AS painLevel, temperature, humidity, weather_code AS weatherCode, memo, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt
